% ============================================================================
%  Load-step transient, kickers off vs on. Standalone -- compile with pdflatex.
%  Data: tran_rise.csv / tran_fall.csv, generated by scripts/make_csv.py
%  Columns: t_ns, vout_off_mv, vout_on_mv, iload_ma   (t = 0 is the load edge)
%
%  Conditions: ai_error_amp with back-gate-skewed event assists, 22nm FDSOI cryo models at 4 K (tt), VDD = 1.0 V, Vref = 0.8 V, C_out = 10 pF, load stepped 1 <-> 10 mA through the spdt resistive legs with a 100 ps edge.
%  "off" opens the series switch resistors on P12/N17 (1 Tohm instead of 1 mohm) so the kickers are removed from the pass-gate node; everything else is bit-identical, including the auxiliary event amplifiers, which still run.
%  The two runs sit on independent adaptive time grids, so the "off" trace is linearly interpolated onto the "on" trace's time points.
%
%  Settling to +/-8 mV (1 % of 0.8 V), measured as LAST exit from the band: rising edge 39.7 ns -> 5.1 ns, falling edge 37.4 ns -> 10.0 ns. The kickers do not change the droop depth (-81 mV) or the overshoot (+83 mV); they only shorten the recovery.
% ============================================================================
\documentclass[border=5pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}
\usepackage{siunitx}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}

\pgfplotsset{
  width=9cm, height=5.2cm,
  xlabel={Time [\si{\nano\second}]},
  ylabel={$V_\text{OUT}$ [\si{\milli\volt}]},
  grid=both, grid style={gray!25},
  tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\small, cells={anchor=west}, draw=gray!50},
  title style={yshift=-1.2ex, font=\small},
  every axis plot/.append style={line width=0.9pt},
}

% ---------------- rising load edge: 1 -> 10 mA ----------------
\begin{axis}[
  name=rise,
  title={Load step up: \SI{1}{}$\to$\SI{10}{\milli\ampere}},
  xmin=-1, xmax=62, ymin=710, ymax=810,
  legend pos=south east,
]
\addplot[gray, dashed] table[x=t_ns, y=vout_off_mv, col sep=comma] {tran_rise.csv};
\addlegendentry{kickers off}
\addplot[blue] table[x=t_ns, y=vout_on_mv, col sep=comma] {tran_rise.csv};
\addlegendentry{kickers on}
\draw[red!60, dashed] ({rel axis cs:0,0}|-{axis cs:0,808}) -- ({rel axis cs:1,0}|-{axis cs:0,808});
\draw[red!60, dashed] ({rel axis cs:0,0}|-{axis cs:0,792}) -- ({rel axis cs:1,0}|-{axis cs:0,792});
\end{axis}

% ---------------- falling load edge: 10 -> 1 mA ----------------
\begin{axis}[
  name=fall, at={(rise.south east)}, xshift=20mm, anchor=south west,
  title={Load step down: \SI{10}{}$\to$\SI{1}{\milli\ampere}},
  xmin=-1, xmax=67, ymin=790, ymax=890,
  legend pos=north east,
]
\addplot[gray, dashed] table[x=t_ns, y=vout_off_mv, col sep=comma] {tran_fall.csv};
\addlegendentry{kickers off}
\addplot[blue] table[x=t_ns, y=vout_on_mv, col sep=comma] {tran_fall.csv};
\addlegendentry{kickers on}
\draw[red!60, dashed] ({rel axis cs:0,0}|-{axis cs:0,808}) -- ({rel axis cs:1,0}|-{axis cs:0,808});
\draw[red!60, dashed] ({rel axis cs:0,0}|-{axis cs:0,792}) -- ({rel axis cs:1,0}|-{axis cs:0,792});
\end{axis}

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
